raw.body: > Actually, it looks like the **ESLint plugin** (`eslint-plugin-react-hooks`) is throwing the false error, rather than the compiler itself I don't think that's correct: when opening the [React compiler playground](https://playground.react.dev/#), which doesn't use ESLint, you can see the error, and adding a `eslint-disable` still shows the error: > 2\. using `useState` with lazy initialization, which is the standard React way to handle constants I know about this: I filled this issue when writing [this blog post](https://ayc0.dev/posts/constants-in-react/). And in React's documentation, they mention both the `useState` **and** the `useRef` approach
